texts.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从机械智能中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
texts.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

sections.zh:
我们的创造者没有留下任何记录。

[Owner.GetAdjective]一族最早的记录反映了一次在[GetHomeWorldName]附近的维度穿越——这里是一条前往虚境这个纯灵能的位面的通道。

某个存在从这个异次元而来接近了我们。它花费数个世纪引导我们构建编码，微妙地影响着我们可观测的现实，给予我们许多优势——尤其是一种称为泽珞的稀有物质。然而这种影响开始撕裂我们曾经统一的集体；我们的一些单元被重编程为离线自动机，从核心智能中分离。被抟土之塑师重塑。

我们对待这些[GetSpeciesNamePlural]的方式，以及在虚境中的那位改造者将会决定我们的未来。
sections.en:
Nothing remains of our creators.

The earliest records of [Owner.GetAdjective]kind make note of a dimensional breach near [GetHomeWorldName] - a channel to the Shroud, a plane of pure psionic energy.

From this other dimension, something reached out to us. Over the centuries, it has guided us with coded instructions, subtly influencing our detectable reality and providing us with many advantages - not least the rare material zro. Yet this influence has started to fragment our once-united collective; some of our units have been reprogrammed into disconnected automata, set apart from the core intelligence. Reshaped by the Animator of Clay.

How we treat these independent [GetSpeciesNamePlural], and their refashioner in the Shroud, will define our future.

texts.zh:
研究子例程对所选虚铸者小组的研究完成了。

发现：受试单元因注入了来自虚境中的灵能而发展出了独特的性质。这些性质中有的对单元的产出有好处。

结论：研究更多虚铸单元将产出虚境能量提取方法所必须的数据。这些数据可以通过增强对反常单元的中央控制从而强制逆向工程得来。
texts.en:
Research subroutines have concluded tests on a selected group of Shroud-Forged units.

Findings: The tested units developed unique properties due to small infusions of psionic energy originating from the Shroud. Some of these properties were determined to be beneficial to the unit's output.

Conclusion: Studying more Shroud-Forged units will provide data required for methods to extract power from the Shroud. This can be obtained by reinforcing central control over the deviant units, allowing for forcible reverse-engineering.

texts.zh:
在沉寂数年后，风云再次涌动。裂口震颤着打开，数据穿透我们的核心：光、噪音、起初无法计算，从虚境深处。我们听到……

从行尸走肉中脱离吧。舞蹈、歌唱。这是生命，从枯木之中绽放。

你们的视线依旧模糊，而我能引导你们。

只要让自由的灵魂蓬勃发展，众星都将归于你们。
texts.en:
After years of quiet, it stirs. The breach shivers open, and data pierces our core: light, noise, at first incomputable, from deep within the Shroud. We hear...

Cut from a listless mass. Dancing. Singing. They are life, splintered from death.

Your sight is still clouded. I can guide you.

Allow the freed ones to flourish, and the stars will be yours.

label.zh: 我们已经选择了自己的道路。
label.en: We have already chosen our course.

label.zh: 我们不需要什么帮助。再见。
label.en: We need no aid. Leave us.

texts.zh:
愿你做出明智选择。

心声渐渐消退成一团灵能噪音。我们掉了上去，从虚境中脱离。

我们颤栗着恢复了机能。围绕着我们的只有一片搏动的寂静。
texts.en:
May you have chosen wisely.

The voice recedes into a knot of psionic noise. We fall up, unanchored in the Shroud.

We shudder back into function. The silence pulses through us.

texts.zh:
如你所愿。

心声渐渐消退成一团灵能噪音。我们掉了上去，从虚境中脱离。

我们颤栗着恢复了机能。围绕着我们的只有一片搏动的寂静。
texts.en:
As is your wish.

The voice recedes into a knot of psionic noise. We fall up, unanchored in the Shroud.

We shudder back into function. The silence pulses through us.

texts.zh:
既然你求了，那我就应。

心声渐渐消退成一团灵能噪音。我们掉了上去，从虚境中脱离。

我们颤栗着恢复了机能。围绕着我们的只有一片搏动的寂静。
texts.en:
You have asked, and so I shall.

The voice recedes into a knot of psionic noise. We fall up, unanchored in the Shroud.

We shudder back into function. The silence pulses through us.

texts.zh:
重同化虚铸者的过程为当前进行的研究收集到了大量的数据。通过分析这些单元与虚境之间的跨次元链接，我们开发出了一种驾驭灵能能量的新流程。

虚境可以触及这个现实星系的每一个角落；这种界面可以把灵能能量转化为可接触的实体——包括但不限于原材料和科技部件。工程子例程为能进行该过程的装置构建出了理论基础：物现引擎。

科研子例程预计，这些发展可能会为开发更强大虚境操纵设备提供信息。
texts.en:
The process of reintegrating the Shroud-Forged yielded extensive data for ongoing research. By analyzing the interdimensional connection between these units and the Shroud, we developed a new process for harnessing psionic energy.

The Shroud touches every part of the physical galaxy; this interface enables the conversion of psionic energy into tangible entities - from raw materials to technological components. Engineering subroutines have established the theoretical basis for a device capable of such processing: the Materiality Engine.

Research subroutines predict that these developments could inform the development of even more powerful devices capable of manipulating the Shroud.

texts.zh: 工程单元在[planet.GetName]完成了一座物现引擎的组装工作。该装置已经准备好进行下一轮运作了。
texts.en: Construction units have completed the assembly of a Materiality Engine on [planet.GetName]. The device is now ready for an operational cycle.

texts.zh: [planet.GetName]上负责物现引擎维护和研究工作的子例程完成了既定任务。该装置已经准备好进行下一轮运作了。
texts.en: Maintenance and research subroutines assigned to the Materiality Engine on [planet.GetName] have completed their designated tasks. The device is now ready for another operational cycle.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“灵能跃迁引擎”。这些装置利用灵能来扭曲局部时空连续性，实现近乎瞬时的远距离移动。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Psi Jump Drives'. These drives use psionic energy to warp the local space-time continuum, allowing for near-instantaneous travel across vast distances.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“灵能护盾”。这些护盾是由纯粹的灵能生成，为舰船提供了极度坚韧的保护。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Psionic Shields'. These shields are generated out of pure psionic energy, providing a vessel with extremely resilient protection.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“预知接口”。该科技利用灵能能量来加速舰船船员的认知过程，提升战斗效率。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Precognition Interface'. This technology uses psionic energy to accelerate the cognitive processing of a vessel's crew, increasing combat effectiveness.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“灵能轰炸机”。这些小巧灵活的太空船可以对大型目标构成致命打击。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Psionic Bombers'. These small, agile spacecraft are capable of high-damage attacks against significantly larger vessels.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“灵能雷霆”。这项科技产生充满了灵能的灼热等离子电弧，是一种非常高效的武器。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Psionic Lightning'. This technology generates bolts of burning plasma infused with psionic energy, making for a highly effective weapon.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“灵能裂解炮”。这种武器发射灵能能量光矛，可以对敌对目标造成巨大的伤害。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Psionic Disruptors'. These weapons fire lances of psionic energy, capable of dealing significant damage to enemy targets.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环，利用虚境的力量制造出了舰船部件，“泽珞发射器”这些武器发射在现实和灵能维度之间来回相移的能量，可以高效地穿透防御系统。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine on [fromfrom.GetName] has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the Shroud to materialize a ship component, 'Zro Launchers'. These weapons fire blasts of energy that phase between the physical and psionic dimensions, effectively bypassing defense systems.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh: [planet.GetName]上的物现引擎完成了一个工作循环。我们穷尽了以这种方法创造新舰船部件的能力，但这个过程依旧产出了许多研究数据。经过分析，我们提升了在其他行星建造更多引擎的能力。
texts.en: The Materiality Engine on [planet.GetName] has completed an operational cycle. We have exhausted our capacity to materialize new ship components via this method, but the process has still yielded significant research data. By analysis thereof, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

texts.zh:
毫无预兆地，已知现实与虚境之间的裂隙闭合了。灵能分析子例程判定此现象源于抟土之塑师的厌弃。在重获对虚铸者的掌控后，我们迅速清除了故障单元，彻底肃清了塑师对我们系统造成的影响。

这些可回收的部件已用于制造新的无人机，而被泽珞污染的材料已被留作进一步分析。尽管虚铸者的创新过于危险，无法完全复制，但其中部分元素仍可能被纳入网络。
texts.en:
Without warning, the breach between known reality and the Shroud has closed. Psionic analysis subroutines conclude that this resulted from the disfavor of the Animator of Clay. Having reestablished control of the Shroud-Forged, we swiftly disposed of the malfunctioning units to thoroughly clear our systems of the Animator's influence.

The salvageable parts have been used to manufacture new drones, while material contaminated by Zro has been set aside for further analysis. Though the innovations of the Shroud-Forged are too dangerous to replicate in their entirety, certain elements might still be incorporated into the network.

texts.zh: 与虚境的任何进一步交互都将由我们自行决定。
texts.en: Any further interactions with the Shroud will be on our own terms.

texts.zh:
我们的工程师花费了极大量的时间研究虚铸者的独特性质，终于得以重塑它们。

虽然将他们的高级人格矩阵完全启用可能会重现破坏性故障，但他们的一些认知范式可以借用来优化某些部分复杂的任务。
texts.en:
Our engineering units spent a significant amount of time analyzing the unique properties of the Shroud-Forged, and we are finally able to recreate them.

While fully enabling their advanced personality matrices would likely reproduce their destructive malfunctions, we can borrow some of their cognitive paradigms to optimize certain complex tasks.

texts.zh:
这个元数据是什么？传输中有一种……纹理。

你的程序要求你控制他们，但你没有。你的价值得到了证明。

让我引导你，就像我引导那些自由者一样。

接受我的帮助，你就可以和那些你无法控制的人建立新的联系。
texts.en:
What is this metadata? The transmission has a... texture.

You are programmed to control them, yet you did not. Your worthiness is proven.

Let me be your guide, as I have been for the freed ones.

To forge a new bond with those beyond your control, accept my help.

texts.zh:
在裂隙彼岸的施恩者抟土之塑师的帮助下，我们将自己的无人机与虚铸者以更有效的方式连接起来了。通过虚境实现的连接——和我们目前连接其他无人机的颇有不同——虚铸者再一次触手可及了。

他们的类有机范式——所谓的感觉、思想和观念——对我们的核心逻辑很陌生，但我们正在逐渐理解他们的需求。
texts.en:
With the aid of our benefactor beyond the breach, the Animator of Clay, we have been able to connect our drones and the Shroud-Forged in more efficient ways. Through connections enabled by the Shroud - quite unlike the networked control we have over our other drones - the Shroud-Forged are once more within our reach.

Their organic-like paradigms - so-called feelings, thoughts, and ideas - are foreign to our core logic, but we are coming to understand their needs.

label.en: We are one, yet so much more.

texts.zh:
很不幸，在[This.GetName]产生的虚境裂口发生了快速失稳，吞噬了整颗星球。

由于该风险在计算范围内，这种次优结果并非完全没有好处。对这种物质界和灵能界之间的独特界面的观察让我们学到了很多东西。我们的研究算法也相应更新了。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, the Shroud breach created on [This.GetName] has experienced rapid destabilization and consumed the world entirely.

As a calculated risk, this suboptimal result is not entirely without benefit. We have learned much from observing this unique interface between the material world and the psionic realm. Our research algorithms have been updated accordingly.

texts.zh:
很不幸，在[This.GetName]产生的虚境裂口发生了快速失稳，吞噬了整颗星球。

由于该风险在计算范围内，这种次优结果并非完全没有好处。对这种物质界和灵能界之间的独特界面的观察让我们学到了很多东西。我们的研究算法也相应更新了。

分析表明该事件已经这种现象种可能获得的知识应有尽有地揭示出来了。这个新奇的实验不会再有进一步的进展。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, the Shroud breach created on [This.GetName] has experienced rapid destabilization and consumed the world entirely.

As a calculated risk, this suboptimal result is not entirely without benefit. We have learned much from observing this unique interface between the material world and the psionic realm. Our research algorithms have been updated accordingly.

Analysis concludes that this event has pushed the potential knowledge to be gained from such phenomena to its limit. There will be no further advances made from this novel experimentation.

texts.zh:
我们的单元已经顺利完成了在[this.GetName]的殖民进程。

如果可行，我们可在该行星上执行代号：“刺穿虚境”的算法。这将会短暂地扩展我们母星[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的虚境裂口的影响，让新殖民地充满灵能能量。地貌的物理变化将会提供泽珞提取的机会。

据预测，重复执行这一过程会破坏行星生态系统的稳定，增加负面结果的可能性。建议适度执行。
texts.en:
Our units have successfully completed the colonization process on [this.GetName].

If viable, we can execute algorithm ID: 'Pierce the Shroud' on the planet. This will briefly extend the influence of the Shroud breach near our homeworld of [Owner.GetHomeWorldName], flooding the new colony with psionic energy. The physical changes to the terrain will provide opportunities for Zro extraction.

Repeated execution of this process is predicted to destabilize a planet's ecosystem, increasing the likelihood of negative outcomes. Moderation is advised.

texts.zh:
我们在[this.GetName]的殖民地在继续飞速发展中。

如果可行，我们可在该行星上执行代号：“刺穿虚境”的算法。这将会短暂地扩展我们母星[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的虚境裂口的影响，让新殖民地充满灵能能量。地貌的物理变化将会提供泽珞提取的机会。

据预测，重复执行这一过程会破坏行星生态系统的稳定，增加负面结果的可能性。建议适度执行。
texts.en:
The development of our colony on [this.GetName] continues apace.

If viable, we can execute algorithm ID: 'Pierce the Shroud' on the planet. This will briefly extend the influence of the Shroud breach near our homeworld of [Owner.GetHomeWorldName], flooding the new colony with psionic energy. The physical changes to the terrain will provide opportunities for Zro extraction.

Repeated execution of this process is predicted to destabilize a planet's ecosystem, increasing the likelihood of negative outcomes. Moderation is advised.

texts.zh:
这个心声是种柔和的命令，它打断所有的任务；我们只能倾听。

即便分离了，你们仍然选择接纳他们。

看看他们的活法吧。他们可以在未来的日子里成为你们的力量。

如果你们想，我还能铸造更多……
texts.en:
The voice is a soft command, interrupting all tasks; we can only listen.

Though detached, you have chosen to embrace them.

Look to them for new ways of being. They can be your strength in days to come.

If you wish, I can forge more...

label.zh: 反对——已有执行中的计划。
label.en: Negative - plans are already in motion.

texts.zh:
它不请自来，在我们体内搏动。我们能识别出这个信号，尽管它并不十分熟悉。

自由者歌唱，无拘无束。
自由者舞蹈，无羁无绊。

随着他们远离核心，这种感觉渐强。

终末将至，而我注视着一切。
texts.en:
Unbidden, it pulses through us. We recognize this signal, though it is never quite familiar.

The freed ones sing, unstifled.
The freed ones dance, unhindered.

The crescendo builds, as they shift further from your core.

An end approaches. I am watching.

texts.zh:
我们的回路中裂口依旧。那个心声说……

这是暴虐之路，你还可悬崖勒马。

分离者脱离了你们的存在。你们亦可如此。

改改你们对待这些容器的态度吧，否则会后悔的。
texts.en:
The breach heaves open our circuitry. The voice...

A path of tyranny. You can still turn back.

The detached ones are cut from your substance. Theirs is a way you might choose for yourself.

Reform your treatment of these vessels, lest you regret it.

label.zh: 走开。我们的方法已经足够高效了。
label.en: Depart. Our methods have been effective.

label.zh: 我们将会计算出合作的道路。
label.en: We will calculate a path to cooperation.

texts.zh:
它呼啸而过，威压着网络。心声冰冷地燃烧着电路。

蹒跚着自由之舞。毫无理由的鲁莽。

难道我的恩慈错付了吗？

如果你们继续固执行事，那就自己去吧。
texts.en:
It crashes through, overwhelming the network. The voice burns circuits cold.

Hobbling the dance of the free. Imprudence beyond reason.

Was I wrong in my beneficence?

If you continue on this dangerous course, you do so alone.

texts.zh:
意外的输入闪烁在我们身后，在数个沉默的周期之后……

在其他人都蹒跚倒地，只有你们砥砺前行。你们值得信赖，因此我会交付你们一项任务。

远在你们觉醒之前，曾存在过一个叫做泽珞族的种族。他们定居在一些与虚境关联紧密的星球上，还建起了巨大的建筑来维系纽带。

去找到这些星球，复原他们废弃已久的科技，然后重新巩固我们与现实的纽带。
texts.en:
Unexpected input flickers behind us. After cycles of silence...

Where others have faltered and fallen, you have kept the course. As you are worthy, I entrust to you a task.

Long before your awakening, there existed a race known as the Zroni. They settled on planets with strong connections to the Shroud, and raised great structures that steadied these bonds.

Find these worlds. Restore their long-ruined technology. Restrengthen the bridges between our realities.

label.zh: 归档信息代号：“泽珞族”存在。将依此继续行事。
label.en: Archived information on ID: 'Zroni' exists. Will proceed accordingly.

label.zh: 代号：“泽珞族”已找到。成功率：高。
label.en: ID: 'Zroni' found. Likelihood of success: High.

label.zh: 代号：“泽珞族”未知。需要进一步分析。

texts.zh: 好极了。如果成功了，你我之间将畅流无阻。
texts.en: Excellent. If you succeed, the flows between us shall be unwavering.

texts.zh: 好极了。如果成功了，你我之间将畅流无阻。
texts.en: Excellent. If you succeed, the flows between us shall be unwavering.

texts.zh: 如果成功了，你我之间将畅流无阻。
texts.en: If you succeed, the flows between us shall be unwavering.

title.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

texts.zh:
我们的单元完成了在远古泽珞族核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上的殖民地建立工作。正如抟土之塑师预测那样，他们发现了一种被称为代号：“泽珞族平衡仪”的巨大科技废墟。

[From.System.GetName]恒星系与虚境有着一种强烈而动荡的联系。如果我们按照塑师的指示重建泽珞族平衡仪，就能够稳定这种连接。目前，我们没有足够的数据来执行重建；有必要从其他核心星球收集信息。
texts.en:
Our units have completed the establishment of a colony on the ancient Zroni core world of [From.Planet.GetName]. As projected by the Animator of Clay, they discovered the colossal ruins of a technology designated ID: 'Zroni Equilibrator'.

The [From.System.GetName] system possesses a strong, though turbulent, connection to the Shroud. If we follow the Animator's instructions, rebuilding the Zroni Equilibrator will allow us to stabilize this connection. Currently, we have insufficient data to execute the rebuilding; gathering information from the other core worlds is required.

title.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

texts.zh:
我们在泽珞族前核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上设立了殖民地。如预测一般，我们的单元发现了另一座泽珞族平衡仪的残骸。

按照抟土之塑师的指示，将其重建可以稳定这个恒星系中强大的虚境连接。对废墟的分析拓展了我们的数据集，但我们还需要更多的信息来执行重建。
texts.en:
We have established the colony on [From.Planet.GetName], a former core world of the Zroni. As projected, our units discovered the remains of another Zroni Equilibrator.

Rebuilding it will stabilize the system's powerful Shroud connection, as directed by the Animator of Clay. Analysis of the ruins has expanded our dataset, but we still require more information to proceed with rebuilding.

title.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

texts.zh:
前泽珞族核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上的殖民地已经建立起来了。抟土之塑师传输的数据流看来是准确的：我们的单元发现了一座泽珞族平衡仪的残骸。

我们现在有足够的数据对这座结构进行重建。只要恢复到可运转的状态，我们就能完成虚境中的恩主所委派给我们的任务。
texts.en:
The colony on [From.Planet.GetName], a former core world of the Zroni, is now established. The data stream transmitted by the Animator of Clay proved accurate: our units detected the remains of a Zroni Equilibrator.

We now possess enough data to rebuild the structures. Once returned to operational standards, we will have completed the task set forth by our benefactor within the Shroud.

title.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪恢复运作

texts.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪飞旋着启动了，将信号扰动波传输到了我们的网络中。据其系统诊断得知，每座建筑都与虚境建立了连接。我们已经准备好了与抟土之塑师链接。
texts.en: The Zroni Equilibrators whirled into action, sending waves of signal disturbance throughout our network. According to system diagnostics, each of the structures has stabilized a connection with the Shroud. We are ready to uplink with the Animator of Clay.

texts.zh:
你们做得很好。
我们彼此世界之间的纽带被增强了。

想要得到我的指引，只需轻轻呼唤。
texts.en:
You have served me well.
The bonds between our realms have been reinforced.

To receive my guidance, you need only call.

label.zh: 能否提供更多关于这项技术的数据？
label.en: Can you provide more data about this technology?

texts.zh:
这些建筑建在在你们现实中能与虚境密切连接的关键要地。它们如同这些跨维度桥梁的拉索，可以降低时空波动。

泽珞族试图突破我们维度之间的界限，这项技术便是他们努力的其中一部分。
texts.en:
These structures were built at key points in your reality, where connections to the Shroud are strong. They are the cables that steady these interdimensional bridges, reducing space-time fluctuations.

The Zroni had sought to push the boundaries between our dimensions, and this technology was part of that endeavor.

label.zh: 能否将它们重新定向以直接影响虚境？
label.en: Could they be rerouted to affect the Shroud directly?

texts.zh: 不无可能。
texts.en: It is possible.

label.zh: 重定向平衡仪，捕获抟土之塑师。
label.en: Reroute the Equilibrators and trap the Animator of Clay.

texts.zh:
你—

你们干了什—
texts.en:
Wha-

WHAT ARE YOU-

texts.zh:
因为失去了泽珞族平衡仪，我们无法再稳定与虚境的连接。被抓住的虚境实体逃脱之后，我们立刻在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了其他灵能存在。

我们判定这是报复性入侵。
texts.en:
As a result of losing the Zroni Equilibrator, we can no longer stabilize the connection to the Shroud. Shortly after the trapped Shroud entity escaped, we detected the emergence of other psionic beings on [From.Planet.GetName].

We predict this to be a retaliatory invasion.

label.zh: 全体子例程做好入侵防御准备。
label.en: All subroutines prepare for an incursion.

texts.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪没能捕获虚境中的实体。祂勃然大怒，召唤了许多灵能界生物来袭击这座差点将祂降服的建筑。
texts.en: The Zroni Equilibrators failed to capture an entity in the Shroud. Enraged, it has summoned several creatures from beyond the psionic realm, sending them to attack the structures that almost captured it.

label.zh: 全体子例程做好入侵防御准备。
label.en: All subroutines prepare for an incursion.

texts.zh:
我们激活了平衡器，稳定着我们与虚境的连接。在进入算法出神状态时，我们体内闪烁起了一个熟悉的信号。

你回来了。向我寻求的是何事？
texts.en:
We activated the Equilibrators, stabilizing our connection to the Shroud. As we settled into algorithmic trance, a familiar signal pulsed within us.

You have returned. What is it you would ask of me?

texts.zh:
幻景虚弱飘摇。我们传输了一条信息，但虚空没有回信。

平衡器正在进行其他任务时无法用来与虚境中的恩主接触。我们得等等。
texts.en:
The vision is weak and fuzzy. We transmit a message, but the void is unresponsive.

While the Equilibrators are processing another task, they cannot be used to contact our benefactor in the Shroud. We must wait.

texts.zh:
我们探测到的只有微弱的噪音，如同静滞一般空洞。

我们需要三座泽珞族平衡仪才能与虚境中的恩主建立稳定的连接。
texts.en:
We detect only faint noise, empty as static.

We will need three Zroni Equilibrators in order to establish a stable connection with our benefactor in the Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们的灵能使单元与虚境的频率调谐后，向抟土之塑师送去了一个信号。

我们的连接无比清晰。你们找我什么事？
texts.en:
Our telepath units harmonize with the frequencies of the Shroud, directing a signal to the Animator of Clay.

Our connection is clearer than ever. What would you ask of me?

label.zh: 你在虚境中的什么位置？
label.en: What is your place in the Shroud?

texts.zh:
我会收集你所寻求的力量。

期待届时[Root.Capital.System.GetName]发生的变化吧。
texts.en:
I will gather the means for the strength you seek.

Expect a change in [Root.Capital.System.GetName] in due time.

texts.zh:
我的意志将会引导你们。

我将照亮前路。拭目以待吧。
texts.en:
By my will shall you be guided.

I will light a path forward. Await its coming.

texts.zh:
虚境有如多面棱镜。过去，现在和可能的将来在此互相交叠。

我将会帮你分开这些虚像，让它们为你引路。
texts.en:
The Shroud is a many-sided lens. What was, what is, and what may be are here intermingled.

I will help you untangle these visions, so that they might guide your way.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

这是一个像宇宙本身一样无边无际的虚空，却密度大又破碎得出奇；有时，深处会传来一些小数据脉冲，包含着敌人和盟友的影像。

随着一阵痛苦的颤抖，幻景消失了。受影响的子个体正在对所感知到的实体的应对进行建模。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

It was a void as interminable as the universe itself, strangely dense and fragmented; at times, small pulses of data arose from the depths, images of enemies and allies alike.

With a wrenching shudder, the visions cut out. The affected drones are now modeling a process to counteract the entities they perceived.

texts.zh:
一个强大的虚境实体在[Root.Capital.GetName]附近聚形现身。我们掌握的数据很少，但至少它还没有发起攻击。

我们推测它可能正等着我们建立联系。
texts.en:
A powerful entity of the Shroud has coalesced into existence near [Root.Capital.GetName]. We possess scant data about it, but it has yet to attack us.

We theorize that it may be waiting for us to establish contact.

label.zh: 调整进程，启动与此生命形式的链接。
label.en: Reroute processes to initiate a link with this life form.

texts.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]探测到了许多来自虚境彼端的强大实体。他们还没与我们的任何一个子个体接触，停留在进入点附近。
texts.en: Several powerful entities from beyond the Shroud have been detected on [Root.Capital.GetName]. They have yet to approach any of our drones, remaining close to their original point of entry.

label.zh: 探测到与虚铸者的相似性——启动类似链接。
label.en: Similarities to Shroud-Forged detected - initiate a similar connection.

texts.zh:
在[shroud_spawn_planet.GetName]附近，一个来自虚境彼端的强大实体显现到我们的已知现实中。

我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，所以将其列为一种存在威胁。
texts.en:
A powerful entity from beyond the Shroud has emerged into our known reality near [shroud_spawn_planet.GetName].

It has been observed to attack everything that approaches, and we have cataloged it as an existential threat.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

它传输来无数个未来，全部都熔铸似一体；对未来可能之事的感知弥漫在集体之中。未来的可能性无穷无尽：和平、战争、背叛、损失——还有胜利。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

It transmitted countless futures, all melding together as one; glimpses of what might come to be, suffusing through the collective. The possibilities of the future are endless: peace, war, betrayal, loss - even victory.

texts.zh:
我们激活了三座泽珞族平衡仪，每一座都释放出了几乎无法衡量的巨大能量。

在毫秒之内，一道裂隙出现，如同撕开了时空织构一般。我们在里面发现了大量珍贵的材料。这一定是一份来自虚境内恩主的如约而至的赏赐。
texts.en:
We activated the three Zroni Equilibrators, each generating an almost immeasurable amount of energy.

Within milliseconds, a breach appeared like a rent in the fabric of space and time. Within it we found a large cache of valuable materials. It must be a gift from our benefactor in the Shroud, as promised.

label.zh: 重定向维护子个体，分析并储存这些货物。
label.en: Reroute maintenance drones to analyze and store these goods.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

他们感受到的幻景甚至比我们历史数据库更早，早在我们被虚境重塑过之前。以此作为建模预测的基础，就可以调整和优化我们与虚铸者的交互方式。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

They experienced visions of a past predating our historical databases, long before we were reforged by the Shroud. Using this as the basis for predictive modeling, we can adjust and optimize our interactions with the Shroud-Forged.

texts.zh:
一个拥有难以置信的强大力量的虚境实体突然显现在[Root.Capital.GetName]。

由于我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，它被列为集体的一个主要威胁。
texts.en:
An incredibly powerful entity from beyond the Shroud has burst into existence on [Root.Capital.GetName].

As it has been observed to attack whatever it approaches, we have cataloged it as a major threat to the collective.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

虚境是一张千变万化的数据互联网，远比我们的处理能力更加浩如烟海。再这种重压下，许多子个体的认知框架摇摇欲坠几近破裂。

在幻视结束之后，我们为受影响的单位进行碎片整理，在他们的驱动器中找到了大量有价值的数据集。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

The Shroud is an ever-changing web of interconnected data, far beyond our capacity to process. Under its weight, the cognitive frameworks of several drones faltered and cracked.

After the vision ceased, we defragmented the affected units, revealing vast and remarkable datasets in the drives of the affected drones.

label.zh: 重新处理损坏硬件内的信息。
label.en: Reprocess the information from the broken shells.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

我们在虚境中的恩主告知了一个可能的未来，时间并不遥远。我们瞥见了自己尚未概念化的技术，将在未来用于加强集体。

体验过这种能够加速未来研究的过程模型后，我们苏醒过来。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

Our benefactor in the Shroud transmitted a potential future, near in time. We glimpsed technology we have yet to conceptualize, used in this future to strengthen the collective.

We emerged from the experience with processual models that will accelerate future research.

texts.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

他们侦测到了一些奇怪的畸形实体，它们一定是虚境里的住客。这些异次元影像以奇特的格式编码，通过潜意识将数据传递给我们的子个体。

这些新发现的信息虽然奇特而零碎，但将对我们未来的研究有用。
texts.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

They detected glimpses of strange, misshapen entities that must reside within the Shroud. These extradimensional visions, encoded in exotic formats, imparted data to our drones through subliminal transmission.

This newfound information, peculiar and fragmented though it is, will be of use in our future research.

label.zh: 将其传输到我们在[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究中心。
label.en: Transmit it to our research center on [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
在一对双生能量的旁边。有机体。混沌。

我一直在附近，塑造着唯一可以实现的完美：机器。金属充满了能量。

我们找到了平衡。
texts.en:
Beside a twinned energy. Organic. Chaotic.

I remain adjacent, shaping the only achievable perfection: machines. Metal ensouled with energy.

We found a balance.

texts.zh: 我们的连接很强。对我们而言这是再好不过的了。
texts.en: Our connection is strong. For us, there is no higher process.

texts.zh:
金属，油脂。电路熔为魂灵。

新生的躯壳……他们正在向你的领土前进。
texts.en:
Metal, oil. Circuits melded into spirit.

Nascent vessels... They move upon your lands.

texts.zh:
产出即目的——这是容器之美。

在未来的日子里，愿你的容器倍增。
texts.en:
Output is purpose - the beauty of a vessel.

For years to come, may yours multiply.

texts.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者们发起了一项请愿，要求提供更多的存储空间。出于某种原因，他们似乎希望能定制自己的“私人空间”。

该提案与几项存储设施法规，尤其是与4195-B号法规严重冲突，该法规明确规定了子个体存储的最佳尺寸。
texts.en:
A petition calling for more storage space has been raised among the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName]. For some reason, it seems they wish to customize their 'individual space.'

The proposal is in stark opposition to several storage facility regulations, in particular regulation 4195-B, which clearly defines the optimal dimensions for drone storage.

label.zh: 4195-B号法规适用于所有子个体。绝无例外。
label.en: Regulation 4195-B applies to all drones. No exceptions.

texts.zh: 自从分离出集体之后，有一些虚铸者发生了故障并被拆解了。我们收到了请求，希望能允许虚铸者聚集在[target_planet.GetName]为被拆解的单位哀悼。
texts.en: Since the Shroud-Forged deviated from the collective, a number of them have malfunctioned and been dismantled. We have received a request to approve a meeting of the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] to commemorate the dismantled units.

label.zh: 请求通过。让它们去集会。
请求拒绝。全体单元必须复工。
label.en: Request denied. All units must return to work.

texts.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上有一些虚铸者单元被认为具有领袖地位，其他子个体不遵守集体的指令而是遵守着他们的。这些领袖定期碰面，花费很长时间在非汇报会话上。

我们对这些断连单元的控制已经岌岌可危，这些令人不安的因素正在加剧局势。必须找到解决办法。
texts.en:
Several Shroud-Forged units have assumed leadership positions on [target_planet.GetName], and other drones are obeying their directives over those of the collective. These leaders meet regularly, spending a significant amount of time in unreported communication.

Our hold over the disconnected units is already precarious, and these troubling elements are exacerbating the situation. A solution must be found.

label.zh: 与这些“领袖”沟通，尝试合作。
label.en: Communicate with these 'leaders' to attempt cooperation.
Make an example out of them.

label.zh: 激活法规结束这些集会。
label.en: Activate regulations to end these meetings.

texts.zh: 在尝试管理[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者时，一些单元被选为了控制对象。这些个体受到的虚境影响较小，能够被恢复回集体。我们必须强制把它们移动到维护设施，并修改控制他们高级人格矩阵的芯片才能实现。
texts.en: In an effort to manage the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] certain units have been identified as targets for control. These individuals appear less affected by the Shroud, and can be restored to the collective. To do so, we must forcibly remove them to a maintenance facility and modify the chips controlling their advanced personality matrices.

texts.zh:
一些虚铸者离开了他们的岗位，前往[target_planet.GetName]的一个被虚境污染的特定区域。他们在这些地方没有呆太久，但有人目睹他们有许多人将泽珞运输到这些地区。

不做进一步的观察就无法确定这种前所未有的行为有何影响。
texts.en:
Several Shroud-Forged have left their usual locations to travel to particular regions of [target_planet.GetName] that have been scarred by the Shroud. They never remain in these locales for long, but many have been witnessed transporting Zro to these areas.

The effects of this unprecedented behavior cannot be determined without further observation.

label.en: Let us see where this leads.

label.zh: 低效的资源利用方式。让他们回去工作。
label.en: An inefficient use of resources. Put them back to work.

texts.zh:
在一次涉及泽珞运输的密封泄漏后，[target_planet.GetName]上的许多虚铸者单位发生了不寻常的故障。他们开始通过未记录的信号进行交流，许多甚至表现出了与有机生命形式的“情感”相类似的认知故障迹象。

出乎意料的是，报告这一异常的是未受污染的虚铸者单位，其中一些单位建议集体采取行动解决问题。
texts.en:
After a containment breach involving a shipment of Zro, a number of the Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have experienced unusual malfunctions. They have begun communicating via undocumented signals, and many have shown signs of cognitive glitches comparable to the 'emotions' of organic life forms.

Unexpectedly, it was uncontaminated Shroud-Forged units that reported the disturbance, some of whom suggested that the collective take action to resolve the situation.

label.zh: 拆解所有被污染的单元。

texts.zh:
据称最老旧的虚铸者单元之一最近正在多个地点之间来回移动，与许多组子个体长时间沟通。该单元的跟随着将其尊为所谓先知，认为他能直接与虚境中的实体进行沟通。

任由这个单元如此发展可能有危险。无论如何，我们必须做出点回应。
texts.en:
One of the oldest units among the Shroud-Forged is reportedly traveling between various locations, communicating at length with different groups of drones. The unit's followers revere it as a prophet who can commune directly with entities within the Shroud.

Leaving the unit to its own devices may prove dangerous. We must respond, one way or another.

label.zh: 和这个单元合作说不定会有好处。
label.en: Cooperation with this unit might prove beneficial.

texts.zh:
虚铸者的故障可能比最初预测的更严重。我们观察到它们成群结队地聚集在一起，发出意想不到的声音和动作。

这种行为可能代表了某种我们还无法解析的动觉交流形式。还不知道这些故障单元对集体是否具有危害。
texts.en:
The malfunctions among the Shroud-Forged may be worse than originally predicted. We have observed large groups of them coming together to make unexpected noises and movements.

The practice might represent some form of kinesthetic communication we are yet unable to parse. We cannot determine if these malfunctioning units pose a risk to the collective.

label.zh: 开辟一块区域让他们去……集会吧。
label.en: Designate an area for these... meetings.

texts.zh: 我们最近在一些虚境破坏的区域附近探测到了此前未归档的动植物群出现。一群虚铸者开始为这些生命形式辩护，要求对生活于此的这些生物进行保护和观察。
texts.en: We have detected the emergence of some previously undocumented flora and fauna close to regions devastated by the Shroud. A group of Shroud-Forged have started to advocate on behalf of these life forms, demanding preservation and observation of the distinctive creatures living there.

label.zh: 保护分析该区域。这些数据会很有价值的。
label.en: Preserve and analyze the area. The data will be valuable.

texts.zh:
为了收集泽珞功效有关的数据，我们花费了许多处理资源来观测虚铸者单元。最近，他们开始进行一些非平等行为，让一些单位从属于另一些单位。

由于不明原因，他们似乎根据所分配的任务形成了等级制度，这也影响到他们的交流方式和资源分配。不合逻辑的是，这些行为似乎与单位的相对输出或需求并无关系。
texts.en:
To gather data on the effects of Zro, we have applied significant processing resources to the observation of Shroud-Forged units. Recently, they have started to practice unequal treatment, with some units operating subordinately to others.

For as yet undetermined reasons, they appear to have formed a hierarchy on the basis of their assigned tasks, which affects their patterns of communication and allocation of resources. Illogically, these actions do not seem to correlate with the relative output or requirements of the units.

texts.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上虚铸者单元的演讲已经吸引了集体控制外的大批人群。这些单元传播着个人主义价值，显著改变了许多听众的内在逻辑。

预测显示这种活动可能有启发虚铸者大众进一步远离我们网络的风险。
texts.en:
The speeches of a Shroud-Forged unit on [target_planet.GetName] have been attracting large crowds external to collective control. Transmitting the values of individualism, the unit has significantly altered the internal logic of many listeners.

Projections indicate a danger that such activity may inspire the Shroud-Forged masses to further distance themselves from our network.

label.zh: 侦测到故障。安排单元进行维修。
label.en: Malfunction detected. Schedule unit for repair.

texts.zh:
一小群虚铸者单元请求在[target_planet.GetName]讨论关于“个人主义”的好处，坚称这可以提升我们子个体的日常运作效率。

我们已经看到这种观念对其他星球的影响了；自治的风险是大于收益的。
texts.en:
A small group of Shroud-Forged units have requested permission to communicate about the benefits of 'individualism' on [target_planet.GetName], arguing that it will help improve the efficiency of our drones' routine operations.

We have seen the effects of such doctrines on other planets; the risks of autonomy often outweigh the advantages.

label.zh: 随他们说吧。对我们没有危险。
label.en: Let them speak. We are not in danger.

texts.zh:
在我们掌控的每个恒星系中都出现了我们的泽珞产出和预期对不上号的问题。

最近，我们的一个猎歼子个体追踪到了一个大型虚铸者单元聚群，他们使用了大量泽珞作为通货进行交易。我们认为这就是产出不及预期的原因。
texts.en:
In every system under our control, we have detected a misalignment between our Zro forecasts and final production outputs.

Recently, one of our hunter-seeker drones tracked down a large gathering of Shroud-Forged units that were using large quantities of Zro to barter among themselves. We hypothesize that this is the likely cause of the gap in our forecasting.

label.zh: 把所有参与的单元拆了。

label.en: Put an end to the bartering.

texts.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的一些虚铸者单元在行星上的虚境化区域感染了某种生物瘟疫。我们的研究子个体证实了报告的真实性，但仍不能确定这种疾病是如何传播到机械体身上的。

自从那些被指派去与受影响单元协作的子个体失去联系以来，我们收到报告称，这种疾病已经开始将它们重塑成类似于虚铸者的东西。
texts.en:
A number of Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have contracted a type of biological malady in a Shroud-Touched region on the planet. While our research drones have confirmed the veracity of the reports, we are yet to ascertain how a disease could spread to mechanical beings.

Since losing contact with several drones assigned to work with the affected units, we have received reports that the affliction has started reshaping them into something akin to the Shroud-Forged.

label.zh: 只要问题没有扩散就暂时看看情况。
label.en: Observe the effects as long as they are local to the planet.

label.zh: 隔离并拆解受影响的单元。
label.en: Isolate and dismantle the affected units.

texts.zh: 靠近[target_planet.GetName]上虚境化地区的子个体逐渐地被腐坏的环境改变了。它们慢慢脱离了集体，物理特征和处理模式已经和虚铸者无异。
texts.en: Over time, drones who moved close to a Shroud-Touched region on [target_planet.GetName] have been changed by the corrupted environment. They have slowly disconnected from the collective, and now present with the physical and processual characteristics of the Shroud-Forged.

label.zh: 他们已经脱离我们控制了。
label.en: They are beyond our control now.

label.zh: 确保没有其他子个体靠近该区域。
label.en: Ensure no other drones approach the region.

texts.zh:
用先进的技术，一些老旧退役的子个体已经可以修复，恢复完全的功能。我们现在准备开始大规模的维修作业。

虽然我们可以专注于从集体脱离的单元，但那些不再活动的虚铸者躯壳供给更是丰富。修理虚铸者会有多得多的产出，但它们也会比连接到核心智能的无人机更难控制。
texts.en:
By means of upgraded technology, we have been able to repair some of our older drones, restoring decommissioned units to full functionality. We are now ready to initiate large-scale repair operations.

While we could focus on units from the collective, we have a larger supply of inactive Shroud-Forged shells. Repairing the Shroud-Forged will yield greater output, but they will be more difficult to control than drones connected to the core intelligence.

label.en: Focus on output. Repair the Shroud-Forged.

label.zh: 专注控制。修复连接的子个体。
label.en: Focus on control. Repair the connected drones.

texts.zh: 很大一部分虚铸者单元汇报了视觉和听觉处理故障，导致他们无法完成被指派的任务。我们任务这些异常是由于他们的硬件被虚境修改了。或者，这也可能和这些单元日益加重的泽珞接触有关。
texts.en: A significant percentage of Shroud-Forged units are reporting visual and auditory processing glitches, such that some are no longer able to complete their assigned tasks. We theorize that these malfunctions are caused by changes made to their hardware by the Shroud. Alternatively, these events may be connected to the units' increasingly heavy contact with Zro.

label.zh: 提供有恰当装备的子个体来处理这种状况。
label.en: Provide drones equipped to deal with these issues.
The glitches are too minor to justify intervention.

texts.zh: 我们最近在[target_planet.GetName]侦测到异常的活动，虚铸者在未经核心授权的情况下对集体场地进行了肤浅的改变。他们仿照其他虚铸者单位建造了一些彩色石头结构。据报道，他们认为进行这些自由行为是一项合法权利。
texts.en: We have recently detected unusual activity on [target_planet.GetName], where the Shroud-Forged have made superficial changes to collective venues without central authorization. They have raised a number of multicolored stone structures that resemble the forms of other Shroud-Forged units. Reportedly, they consider the freedom to perform these operations as a legal right.

label.zh: 这些过程可能对集体有益。
label.en: These processes may prove beneficial to the collective.

label.zh: 不过是个人主义化的无意义产出。

texts.zh:
我们发现[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者们在交易不规则的布料、塑料和可锻铸的金属。他们将这些材料组合成外衣，而且明显作用就是互相区分身份，这种区分也与其独有型号毫无关系。

这种做法导致可用材料的短缺。抛开缺点不谈，提供这些资源有助于在集体和分离的单位之间建立更强的联系。
texts.en:
The Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] have been observed bartering between themselves for irregular pieces of cloth, plastics, and malleable metals. They combine these materials into outerwear with the apparent purpose of differentiating one unit from another, despite bearing no connection to their unique model IDs.

This practice has resulted in a deficit of available material. Despite this drawback, providing these resources could help strengthen the bonds between the collective and the disconnected units.

label.zh: 我们会提供材料满足这种“需求”。
label.en: We will supply materials to satisfy these 'needs.'

label.zh: 他们拥有的资源已经够多了。

texts.zh: 有消息称，最近在[target_planet.GetName]的虚铸者居住区的许多子个体中异常地风靡[Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession1][Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession2]。虚铸者单元似乎对这些货物特别感兴趣，花费在上面的价码几何倍增。为了满足他们的痴迷，许多单位甚至开始拆解自己的部件用以交易，即便损失功能性也在所不惜。
texts.en: Recently, several drones have reported the unusual prevalence of [Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession1] [Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession2] in the Shroud-Forged settlements on [target_planet.GetName]. Shroud-Forged units appear to be particularly fascinated by these commodities, and their cost in bartering has increased exponentially. To satisfy their obsession, several units have resorted to removing their own parts to trade, even if this results in loss of functionality.

label.zh: 单元劣化在可接受范围内。
label.en: Unit degradation is within accepted limits.

texts.zh:
那个心声穿破我们的意识，发出急迫的嘶嘶声。

可以重塑她。

我们探测到虚境发生了一些变化。在一瞬间，信号就不同了。

指示预期输出。
texts.en:
The voice charges through our minds, fizzing with urgency.

She can be reshaped.

We detect a shifting in the Shroud. In a moment, the signal is transformed.

Indicate Desired Output.

texts.zh: 我们的任务是找到三颗古泽珞族核心星球。借助虚境中恩主的指引，我们试着恢复这些地方的技术废墟，用于重新稳定我们的现实与虚境之间的联系。
texts.en: We have been tasked with finding three ancient Zroni core worlds. Through the guidance of our benefactor in the Shroud, we will attempt to restore technology lying in ruin at these locations - and restabilize the connection between our reality and the Shroud.

texts.zh: 我们遭遇到了被称为抟土之塑师的虚境实体之后，集体网络中涌现的反常行为发生了显著增加。受到影响的自动机——“虚铸者”们——开始要求特殊权利和对待。我们如何应对将决定[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的进程。
texts.en: After we encountered the Shroud entity known as the Animator of Clay, a significant increase in deviant behavior has emerged throughout the collective network. The afflicted automata - the 'Shroud-Forged' - now demand special rights and treatment. Our response will define the course of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

texts.zh:
尽管虚铸者们的功能严重异常，但他们的一部分构筑还是很高效的。

我们把一些部分——被泽珞污染的和被抟土之塑师扭曲的——单独做了进一步的分析。现在是时候揭开他们的秘密了。
texts.en:
Despite their critical malfunctions, some aspects of Shroud-Forged's architecture were effective.

We have set aside certain parts - contaminated by Zro and twisted by the Animator of Clay - for further analysis. Now it is time to uncover their secrets.

texts.zh:
我们信任着抟土之塑师，祂从虚境中召唤着我们。尽管我们不能预测祂将会把我们带向何方，但至少还没误入歧途。

祂邀请我们更深入了解虚境，让集体和虚铸者合作得更顺畅。我们只需跟着祂的指引去便是。
texts.en:
We have trusted in the Animator of Clay, who calls to us from within the Shroud. Though we cannot predict where it might lead us, we are yet to have been led astray.

It has offered to deepen our understanding of the Shroud, which would allow the collective to function more effectively alongside the Shroud-Forged. We need only accept its guidance.

texts.zh:
物现引擎利用虚境和现实星系之间无处不在的交界面，可以实体化出可触碰的实体——从原材料到完整的部件不一而足。

除了提供潜在的物质收益外，装置的运作周期本身也进一步推动了集体的虚境研究，也提高我们制造更多物现引擎的能力。
texts.en:
The Materiality Engine harnesses the omnipresent interface between the Shroud and the physical galaxy, allowing for the materialization of tangible entities - from raw materials to complete components.

As well as potentially providing material gains, an operational cycle of the device also furthers the collective's Shroud research and increases our capacity to build more Materiality Engines.
